criterion: Full draft usefulness requires supported facts, all question obligations, relevant inspectable citations and complete usable prose. Source labels at an obligation paragraph may support its subsequent sentences only when the same cited excerpt actually establishes every claim; machine per-sentence gate is reported separately. No extractive fallback counts.
